title: So... where are my streaks?
body:
For an app named "streaks", I feel like there's too little emphasis on my habit streaks. The only indicator for it is a tiny number under a huge icon for the habit. Not even the widgets show the streak very well. 

It's gets the job done as a habit tracker, but it doesn't actually have any strong visual indicators of any streaks you have going on.
author: EnriKCaps

title: WIDGETS please
body: Great app. Does its purpose. Works well with Mac and iPad as well. Would appreciate if widgets can be added.
author: Chris AQ

title: Love the app! —with reservations
body: It’s good to have this app during the months I am studying, though I’d love there to be a feature like a vacation mode. I have several tasks that go on pause for extended periods of time, and it’s a big hassle to go through and pause them one by one.
author: MiguelSingian

title: All in one habit tracker and pomodoro
body: Great design and functionality. Allows you to do customizations in all aspects of the app, from UI to tasking options. This is the best habit tacker app ever.
author: CSMaguinsay

title: Very helpful!
body: This is what helped me to get started with almost everything I want to accomplish! Great job!
author: JAngela2026

title: There should be a fasting task
body: Fasting has been a common habit that people want to practice. I hope the app would include a Fasting preloaded habit. Like on the first click it will start the fast and 2nd click will end the fast
author: carlod_cm

title: Great app!
body: Great app, allows me to check my daily goal, however, wish that I can install it for free on my mac since I already bought it here on my iPhone.
author: KarlKDA

title: Wonderful. Simple and Great.
body:
- You can’t have more than 12 habits. This seems very small but trust me it’s not. Unless you’re using it to track absolutely everything, 12 habits is a lot.
- You can assign url actions to habits. This makes it easier to achieve habits such as “Write 500 words” because you can link it to your Apple Notes.
- You can remove the “Yesterday or Today” prompt. It’s pretty annoying for many habits since it somewhat encourages you to cheat.
- You can also remove the “Task Suggestions” prompt which I encourage you to do. It’s downright annoying for habits like “Workout”.
author: Paul David dcac

title: Please make an undo button
body: Please make an undo button and be able to mark unmarked dates
author: Thomas Diaz

title: Very Poor Interface!
body: Very confusing to use, not clear on how to mark and really track the habits. Just not user friendly at all. Waste of my money.
author: kashina-milunda

title: Good but needs Customization
body: It's a good app. I believe the limit of 12 tasks is a good thing as tracking down more than a dozen habits seems like an overkill. Anyway, the app badly needs more customization. It would be fun to add custom font, custom color and dark mode that is not tied to system settings.
author: Incessant Ant

title: Great app!
body: Definitely helping me create good habits with little effort cost and friction. Three weeks in and I'm already seeing the changes I want.

title: Great app to form habits
body: But I hope there can be more than 6 tasks!! There are a lot of icons that could be used for more tasks 😭
